standard: DIN 509 (undercuts for ground shoulders) / DIN 76-1 (thread runouts and undercuts)
title: Undercuts and thread runouts (Freistiche, Gewindeauslaeufe)
notes: DIN 509 callout: 'DIN 509 - E1x0,4' or 'Freistich DIN 509 - F 0,6x0,3' = form, radius r x depth t1.
Form E: relief into the cylindrical surface only (shaft ground on the diameter). Form F: relief into the cylinder and the shoulder face (both ground).
Undercuts change the volume very little. Model them only when the drawing dimensions them; otherwise record them in an info review flag.
Values below are approximate design values; check width f and the recommended diameter range in the Tabellenbuch before relying on them.

Thread runout (DIN 76-1): for an external thread the incomplete thread x1 is about 2.5 * P; for an internal thread e1 is about 4 * P (normal). Use only when the drawing does not dimension the usable thread length.
